summary: Trisha Montgomery, 40, of Lafayette injured her left ankle hiking the Fern Canyon trail in south Boulder, just above the "rock steps" ~4-5 miles from the trailhead at 1245 Wildwood Road; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Boulder Mountain Parks & Open Space, and Boulder Fire Department responded with Sheriff's deputies and evacuated her down the trail via wheeled litter in an ~3-hour operation (BCSO case 15-4055)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group (with Boulder County Sheriff's Office)
notes: DATE PIN — BCSO release dated Monday 2015-07-20; zero Boulder 2015-07-20 rows and zero Montgomery/Fern Canyon rows before insert.
